# Sienna Shea Butter

> Small-batch Hibiscus Infused Shea Butter, handmade in Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa, for moisture-focused natural-hair routines.

Sienna Shea Butter is handmade in small batches in Centurion by founder Mashudu, who began making it in 2019 for her own natural hair. The Hibiscus Infused Shea Butter comes in two sizes: 250 ml for R180 and 125 ml for R100. Customers order directly through WhatsApp. Free collection in Eco Park, Centurion can be arranged privately, and nationwide Aramex courier delivery starts from R120. The Google Business Profile is rated 5.0 stars from 21 reviews (October 2026).

## Product facts

- Name: Sienna Hibiscus Infused Shea Butter
- Sizes and prices: 250 ml jar R180 (ZAR); 125 ml jar R100 (ZAR)
- Made in: Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa, by founder Mashudu
- Ingredients: Butyrospermum parkii butter (shea butter), herbal-infused Cocos nucifera oil, Olea europaea oil, vitamin E, arrowroot powder, essential oils, fragrance oil.
- Intended use: cosmetic, moisture-focused hair care for natural, afro, coily, curly, 4C, mixed-texture and relaxed hair routines.
- Typical jar life: about one to two months for the 250 ml jar, depending on hair length, density and use.

## Where to buy

- Order on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/27607729916
- Collection: free, in Eco Park, Centurion, by arrangement (exact address shared on WhatsApp). Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00.
- Delivery: Aramex courier across South Africa from R120; the final cost depends on the destination.
- Payment: EFT or cash, confirmed directly with Sienna on WhatsApp.

## Care and safety

Sienna is a cosmetic hair butter, not a medical treatment. It does not grow hair, and it does not treat or cure alopecia, hair loss, dandruff, eczema, scalp conditions, stretch marks, dark marks or sunburn. It is not a sunscreen. Patch test before use, avoid the eyes, and stop use if irritation occurs. The formula contains essential and fragrance oils; for babies or people with eczema or very sensitive skin, seek advice from a qualified healthcare professional first.
